title.zh: 穆斯林法管理（外国清真认证机构）规则 2025
title.en: Administration of Muslim Law (Foreign Halal Certification Bodies) Rules 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 9 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Rules are the Administration of Muslim Law (Foreign Halal Certification Bodies) Rules 2025 and come into operation on 1 October 2025.

heading.en: Fees for application and recognition as foreign halal certification body

text.en:
2.—(1) An application for recognition of a person, authority or entity as a foreign halal certification body under section 88AA(1) of the Act must be accompanied by the application fee specified in the Schedule.
(2) Upon the grant of recognition of the person, authority or entity as a foreign halal certification body, the recognition fee set out in the Schedule is payable to the Majlis.

3.—(1) The Majlis may require any employee of —
(a)an applicant for recognition as a foreign halal certification body; or
(b)a foreign halal certification body,
to undergo such training course or assessment for competency in such manner as the Majlis may specify.
(2) The Majlis may require an applicant for recognition as a foreign halal certification body, or a foreign halal certification body, to undergo such audit in such manner as the Majlis may specify, and the audit is to be conducted by or under the supervision of the Majlis or by any accounting entity or auditor appointed by the Majlis.
(3) The appropriate fee for the assessment for competency or the audit, as specified in the Schedule, is payable to the Majlis by the applicant for recognition as a foreign halal certification body, or the foreign halal certification body.

4. A foreign halal certification body must not transfer or assign the benefit of its recognition under section 88AA(1) of the Act to any other person, authority or entity without the written consent of the Majlis.

5. If any person, authority or entity recognised as a foreign halal certification body fails to comply with rule 3 or 4, or with any conditions or limitations imposed under section 88AA(4) of the Act, the Majlis may —
(a)revoke or suspend the recognition of the person, authority or entity as a foreign halal certification body;
(b)impose additional conditions or limitations on the foreign halal certification body; or
(c)vary the conditions or limitations imposed on the foreign halal certification body.
6. An offence under section 88AA(6) of the Act may be compounded by the Majlis in accordance with section 88E of the Act.
7. To avoid doubt, section 88H of the Act applies to any decision of the Majlis made under these Rules.

heading.en: Time bar for application for recognition

text.en:
8.—(1) Paragraph (2) applies to a person, authority or entity (called in this rule an appellant) who appeals to the Appeal Committee under section 88H of the Act against a decision of the Majlis —
(a)to refuse the appellant’s application for recognition as a foreign halal certification body; or
(b)to revoke or suspend the appellant’s recognition as a foreign halal certification body.
(2) An appellant whose appeal mentioned in paragraph (1) is rejected by the Appeal Committee under section 88I(4)(a) of the Act must not submit an application to be recognised as a foreign halal certification body within a period of one year after the date of the notification of the Appeal Committee’s decision to reject the appeal.
